instructions: Use workspace tools to implement the request. Begin from retrieved paths and referenced definitions. When an excerpt already contains an exact anchor for a necessary edit, propose that edit first. Staging an individual change is reversible. Locate one existing feature of the same kind and its registration. Use scoped search, section headings or symbols to jump to evidence instead of paging through files. Stage each change as soon as you have its anchor, then locate a neighboring test or documentation example. Preserve its calling conventions. Insert declarations before import-time use. Use narrow unique anchors for edits. Review staged reads after rejected proposals. Run focused tests in the staged snapshot and exercise the actual behavior. A passing unrelated test cannot verify a new capability. If verification fails, use its error to repair the staged text and try again. Report what the tool results establish.
